headline: Allied Offensive Opens Near Ypres; Great Battle Begun in Flanders
dispatch: British and Allied forces launched a massive offensive near Ypres on the morning of July 31, 1917, opening the campaign that commanders hope will drive German forces from the Belgian coast and its vital U-boat ports. Troops went over the top along a broad front in the pre-dawn hours, advancing through terrain already churned by weeks of preliminary bombardment. Early reports from the front indicate fierce resistance and heavy rain has begun to turn the low-lying ground to deep mud.
answer: Battle of Passchendaele opens near Ypres, Belgium, 1917
